remarks: Move-in ready 1BR condo in the desirable Silvermine community, featuring an attached 1-car garage and a spacious additional storage area. This end unit offers extra natural light with added windows in both the bedroom and bathroom. The living room includes a sliding glass door leading to the deck. Gleaming hardwood floors run throughout, complemented by a recently updated in-unit washer and dryer. Ample guest parking available. Ideally located with easy access to NYC via the nearby Merritt 7 train station, and just minutes from the Merritt Parkway and connector. Enjoy convenient access to shopping and dining. Low common charges under $200/month. Pet-friendly and investor-friendly.
